Two photographs of the KEMi Inaugural Symposium (University of Washington), 2026-10-22.
Event page: https://kemi.uw.edu/kemi-inaugural-symposium (saved as source-page-kemi-symposium.html, fetched 2026-11-05)
Author: not named on the page; the page is published by the Kren Engineering-based
Medicine Initiative (KEMi), University of Washington.
License: none is stated on the page. The owner of this site, who appears in both
photographs, supplied the two files on 2026-11-05 from their own copy, downloaded
from the page on 2026-11-04. The owner confirmed on 2026-11-05
that KEMi has given permission to reproduce them; they are used with that
permission, credited to KEMi, and nothing about them implies KEMi's endorsement
of this site.
Originals, as served by the page:
  https://kemi.uw.edu/sites/default/files/2026-11/1-poster-750x500.jpg (750 x 500 px)
  https://kemi.uw.edu/sites/default/files/2026-11/kemi-symposium-group-banner.jpg (1300 x 491 px)
Seen: three people standing beside the poster "Integrating Engineering and
Rehabilitation Medicine to Improve Healthcare and Assistive Technology Access and
Customizability"; and seventeen people standing in a row in front of a projection
screen, a KEMi banner at the right.
